GBW is gm1/Cc, about 5.3 MHz. gm6 is about 280 uS, putting p2 above 3.5 times GBW, and the Rz LHP zero lifts PM above 70 deg. Predicted slew is about 5 V/us. The CS output stage swings about 1.3 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),       # input pair L (flicker noise, gain)
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 2.0),       # PMOS mirror load / 2nd-stage driver L
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 2.0),       # NMOS current-source L
    "I6":    (28e-6, 18e-6, 32e-6), # second-stage current
    "Cc":    (1.8e-12, 1.0e-12, 3.0e-12),
    "rzf":   (2.5, 1.2, 4.0),       # Rz = rzf/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = iref                      # 1:1 tail mirror
    i1 = itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]
    gmid_n = 10.0                     # NMOS current sources
    gmid_p = 10.0                     # PMOS mirror + driver (same density -> low systematic offset)

    # bias + current sources (NMOS, same L and gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=None or 0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], itail, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load and 2nd stage driver (same L, gm/Id)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["rzf"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> 2nd stage inversion gives non-inverting vinp
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "y", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = a1 * a2
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + c1 * cout + Cc * cout))
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if Rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else -1e30
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2))
    if fz > 0:
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz))
    pm = min(pm, 89.0)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + I6)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    # Settling estimate: slew portion plus about 4.6 tau of linear settling (step about 0.5 V)
    settle = 0.5 / slew * 0.5 + 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    # Thermal noise estimate (flicker noise is handled by the simulator; L1 is long to keep it low)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sth = 2 * 4 * kT * (2/3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(sth) * 4.0          # crude 1/f multiplier at 1 kHz
    # CMRR: limited by tail output conductance
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * a1 / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) * 1.0 / max(a1, 1e-9) * (m3.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)) / 2)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    pred = {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": gbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise,
        "psrr_db": db(A0) + 6,
        "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, db(A0) + 10),
        "swing": swing,
        "polarity": 1,
    }
    return n, pred
